correctness.rationale: The published M12 nonequivariant homotopy is a wedge of three 2-spheres. Since the reflection fixes vertex 0, Armstrong gives π1(quotient)=1. The exact orbit barycentric chain construction yields 5,646 regular cells. The complete certificate replays 2,768 elementary collapses, verifying unique incident coface, unit incidence and maximality; its final 2D complex has f=(20,54,36), χ=2 and connected 1-skeleton. Since it is simply connected and 2-dimensional, H2=Z and Hurewicz+homological Whitehead produce S². A real final-path replay outputs ALL_VERIFY_OK; finite checks are not generalized beyond M12.

value.rationale: M12 is the first Möbius-ladder parameter where the recent unquotiented classification has three sphere summands, making its reflection quotient a naturally motivated test case. Prior rational characters predict only a Betti number; the new complete integral homotopy classification determines that the quotient is exactly S², without π1 or torsion, by a reproducible 2,768-pair elementary-collapse certificate. No arbitrary parameter slice or mere known-table recomputation is involved. The theorem does not assert a larger infinite family.
